stories.title: Police appeal to find missing teenager last seen at Talacre
stories.summary: North Wales Police are appealing for help to find a missing 16-year-old. Rhys was last seen at Talacre Beach Resort on Sunday 19 July at around 7.30pm. stories.title: Firefighters tackle blaze at Hope Mountain
stories.summary: North Wales Fire and Rescue Service crews are tackling a fire on Hope Mountain. Local residents are being urged to keep windows and doors closed to stop smoke entering their homes. stories.title: Andy Burnham becomes prime minister, launches rough sleeping drive
stories.summary: Andy Burnham has become prime minister, succeeding Keir Starmer. He used his first speech outside 10 Downing Street to announce a national drive to end rough sleeping, backed by an additional £340 million in funding. stories.title: Flintshire councillor’s motion demands probe into scrapped planning votes
stories.summary: Flintshire County Council will debate a motion on Tuesday calling for an investigation into why roll-call voting was scrapped at Planning Committee, according to papers published ahead of the meeting.
